package config

import (
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestValidateRequiresDistinctInboundAndStudentTokens(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mutate := range []func(*Config){
		func(config *Config) { config.TeacherServiceToken = config.InternalAPIToken },
		func(config *Config) { config.PracticeServiceToken = config.InternalAPIToken },
		func(config *Config) { config.PracticeServiceToken = config.TeacherServiceToken },
		func(config *Config) { config.StudentServiceWriteToken = config.StudentServiceToken },
		func(config *Config) { config.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken = config.CourseServiceToken },
		func(config *Config) { config.TZPlannerServiceToken = config.TeacherServiceToken },
		func(config *Config) { config.TZPlannerServiceToken = config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken },
	} {
		config := validConfig()
		mutate(&config)
		if err := config.Validate(); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("expected shared dedicated token to be rejected")
		}
	}
}

func TestOnboardingHandoffTokenIsRequiredOnlyWhenEnabledAndDistinctWheneverConfigured(t *testing.T) {
	config := validConfig()
	config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken = ""
	if err := config.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("flag-off S6-compatible config: %v", err)
	}
	for _, token := range []string{
		config.InternalAPIToken, config.TeacherServiceToken, config.PracticeServiceToken,
		config.StudentServiceToken, config.StudentServiceWriteToken, config.CourseServiceToken, config.AIPromptServiceToken,
		config.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken, config.TZPlannerServiceToken,
	} {
		config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken = token
		if err := config.Validate(); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("flag-off accepted shared handoff token %q", token)
		}
	}
	config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken = ""
	config.GraphReadinessEnabled = true
	config.OnboardingHandoffEnabled = true
	if err := config.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected enabled handoff without token to be rejected")
	}
	for _, token := range []string{
		config.InternalAPIToken, config.TeacherServiceToken, config.PracticeServiceToken,
		config.StudentServiceToken, config.StudentServiceWriteToken, config.CourseServiceToken, config.AIPromptServiceToken,
		config.CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken, config.TZPlannerServiceToken,
	} {
		config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken = token
		if err := config.Validate(); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("enabled accepted shared handoff token %q", token)
		}
	}
	config.TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken = "teacher-handoff"
	if err := config.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid enabled handoff token: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestOnboardingHandoffRequiresGraphReadiness(t *testing.T) {
	config := validConfig()
	config.OnboardingHandoffEnabled = true
	if err := config.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected handoff without graph readiness to be rejected")
	}
	config.GraphReadinessEnabled = true
	if err := config.Validate(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("valid handoff configuration: %v", err)
	}
}

func TestValidateRequiresLeaseLongerThanOneDownstreamCall(t *testing.T) {
	config := validConfig()
	config.WorkerLeaseTTL = config.DownstreamHTTPTimeout
	if err := config.Validate(); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected unsafe worker lease to be rejected")
	}
}

func TestValidateRequiresWorkerLeaseToCoverDownstreamTimeoutWithMargin(t *testing.T) {
	testCases := []struct {
		name      string
		timeout   time.Duration
		lease     time.Duration
		wantValid bool
	}{
		{name: "defaults retain exact margin", timeout: 10 * time.Second, lease: 30 * time.Second, wantValid: true},
		{name: "local Codex timeout retains exact margin", timeout: 135 * time.Second, lease: 155 * time.Second, wantValid: true},
		{name: "lease below margin is rejected", timeout: 135 * time.Second, lease: 155*time.Second - time.Millisecond, wantValid: false},
		{name: "max duration does not overflow", timeout: time.Duration(1<<63 - 1), lease: time.Duration(1<<63 - 1), wantValid: false},
	}

	for _, testCase := range testCases {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			config := validConfig()
			config.DownstreamHTTPTimeout = testCase.timeout
			config.WorkerLeaseTTL = testCase.lease
			err := config.Validate()
			if (err == nil) != testCase.wantValid {
				t.Fatalf("Validate() error = %v, want valid=%t", err, testCase.wantValid)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestLoadDefaultWorkerTimingsSatisfyMargin(t *testing.T) {
	for name, value := range map[string]string{
		"HTTP_ADDR": "", "DATABASE_URL": "", "NATS_URL": "",
		"INTERNAL_API_TOKEN":                     "general",
		"TEACHER_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN":         "teacher",
		"PRACTICE_TASK_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN":   "practice",
		"STUDENT_SERVICE_URL":                    "",
		"STUDENT_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN":         "student-read",
		"STUDENT_SERVICE_LEARNING_PLANNER_TOKEN": "student-write",
		"COURSE_SERVICE_URL":                     "",
		"COURSE_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN":          "course-write",
		"COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_TOKEN":        "course-diagnostic",
		"AI_PROMPT_SERVICE_URL":                  "",
		"AI_PROMPT_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN":       "ai",
		"TZ_PLANNER_SERVICE_URL":                 "",
		"TZ_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN":              "tz-planner",
		"DOWNSTREAM_HTTP_TIMEOUT":                "",
		"PROJECT_AUTHORING_HTTP_TIMEOUT":         "",
		"PROJECT_AUTHORING_LEASE_TTL":            "",
		"PROJECT_AUTHORING_MAX_ATTEMPTS":         "",
		"WORKER_POLL_INTERVAL":                   "",
		"WORKER_LEASE_TTL":                       "",
		"WORKER_MAX_ATTEMPTS":                    "",
		"OUTBOX_POLL_INTERVAL":                   "",
		"OUTBOX_LOCK_TTL":                        "",
		"OUTBOX_PUBLISH_TIMEOUT":                 "",
		"OUTBOX_RETRY_BASE":                      "",
		"OUTBOX_RETRY_MAX":                       "",
		"OUTBOX_BATCH_SIZE":                      "",
	} {
		t.Setenv(name, value)
	}

	config, err := Load()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if config.DownstreamHTTPTimeout != 10*time.Second || config.WorkerLeaseTTL != 30*time.Second {
		t.Fatalf("default timings = %s/%s, want 10s/30s", config.DownstreamHTTPTimeout, config.WorkerLeaseTTL)
	}
}

func TestGraphReadinessFeatureFlagDefaultsOffAndParsesExactly(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED", "")
	if enabled, err := boolean("PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED", false); err != nil || enabled {
		t.Fatalf("default enabled=%t err=%v", enabled, err)
	}
	t.Setenv("PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED", "true")
	if enabled, err := boolean("PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED", false); err != nil || !enabled {
		t.Fatalf("explicit enabled=%t err=%v", enabled, err)
	}
	for _, invalid := range []string{"TRUE", "1", "yes"} {
		t.Setenv("PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED", invalid)
		if _, err := boolean("PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED", false); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted non-exact boolean %q", invalid)
		}
	}
}

func validConfig() Config {
	return Config{
		HTTPAddr: ":8080", DatabaseURL: "postgres://db/planner", NATSURL: "nats://nats:4222",
		InternalAPIToken: "general", TeacherServiceToken: "teacher", TeacherOnboardingHandoffToken: "teacher-handoff", PracticeServiceToken: "practice",
		StudentServiceURL: "http://student:8081", StudentServiceToken: "student-read",
		StudentServiceWriteToken: "student-write", CourseServiceURL: "http://course:8080",
		CourseServiceToken: "course-write", CourseDiagnosticCatalogToken: "course-diagnostic", AIPromptServiceURL: "http://ai:8091",
		AIPromptServiceToken: "ai", DownstreamHTTPTimeout: 10 * time.Second,
		TZPlannerServiceURL: "http://tz-planner:8080", TZPlannerServiceToken: "tz-planner",
		ProjectAuthoringHTTPTimeout: time.Minute, ProjectAuthoringLeaseTTL: 2 * time.Minute, ProjectAuthoringMaxAttempts: 8,
		WorkerPollInterval: time.Second, WorkerLeaseTTL: 30 * time.Second, WorkerMaxAttempts: 5,
		OutboxPollInterval: time.Second, OutboxLockTTL: 10 * time.Minute,
		OutboxPublishTimeout: 5 * time.Second, OutboxRetryBase: time.Second,
		OutboxRetryMax: time.Minute, OutboxBatchSize: 50,
	}
}
